highlights: All staff trained in child protection and safeguarding annually
Designated safeguarding lead and deputy safeguarding leads
Safer Recruitment training for staff involved in hiring
Full identity, qualification, background, and police checks for all employees
safety.policy_summary: The International School of Samui maintains a comprehensive child protection and safeguarding policy ensuring high levels of student welfare. All employees undergo strict background, police, and qualification checks following Safer Recruitment guidelines, and all staff receive annual child protection training.
